traits.zh: 招牌日式厚吐司松软，配冰拿铁
traits.en: Signature Japanese-style thick toast is soft, served with iced latte

traits.zh: 提供桂花拿铁、黄油啤酒拿铁、白玉桂花拿铁
traits.en: Serves osmanthus latte, butter beer latte, and white mochi osmanthus latte
Approximately 8–10 seats with wooden tables and chairs

traits.zh: 整面临街落地窗，采光良好
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows provide ample natural light

linger.zh: 座位少但舒适，主打吐司+咖啡慢食组合
linger.en: Few seats but cozy; toast-and-coffee combo invites lingering

adventure.zh: 有黄油啤酒拿铁、白玉桂花拿铁等创意饮品
adventure.en: Creative drinks like butter beer and white mochi osmanthus lattes
